items.title: Derrick Gardner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 9, 2013
items.q: And for instance there’s a piece in there, an Ernie Wilkins’ piece called “Right On Right On.”

ctx.x: I can see you calling the Registrar. That’s a good story. And were you basically sight reading, or you knew some of the music?

Well yeah. I knew some of the music, but the Basie band has their own way of playing what is written on the page, which makes the band sound particularly unique. And for instance there’s a piece in there, an Ernie Wilkins’ piece called “Right On Right On.” © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -5-

And it’s figured a quarter rest followed by four eighth notes, eighth rest, followed by an eighth note tied over. And so I saw it and I said [scats]. So we got to it and this is the B shout section, right, you know. And so we get to it and the whole band goes [scats]. And I’m going [scats].
